problem: Why not expose document context, queries and templates as one generic tool?
principle: Tools execute capabilities; resources supply application-selected context; prompts supply selectable message templates. Each has distinct discovery and access rules.
check: Does returning a prompt start an agent?
answer: No. The host decides whether to use the messages and invoke a model.
